arabic text: Maara gaya, tera chacha, Ay meri Sakina
english translation text: Your uncle has been killed, O my Sakina

arabic text: Darya pe yehi shor tha Ay meri Sakina\nMaara gaya, tera chacha, Ay meri Sakina
english translation text: This cry rose beside the river O my Sakina\nYour uncle has been killed, O my Sakina

arabic text: Paani ki aas chor de, kuzon ko apne tor de\nKhun rorahi hai alqama Ay meri Sakina\nMaara gaya, tera chacha, Ay meri Sakina
english translation text: Abandon the hope of water; break your little cups\nThe Alqama is weeping blood O my Sakina\nYour uncle has been killed, O my Sakina

arabic text: Abbas ab na aae ge, tujhko la’een sataaege\nDaaman jalega ab tera Ay meri Sakina\nMaara gaya, tera chacha, Ay meri Sakina
english translation text: Abbas will not return now; the accursed ones will torment you\nYour dress will now be burned O my Sakina\nYour uncle has been killed, O my Sakina

arabic text: Ab to tamaache khaaegi, sine pe so na paaegi\nSaaya pidar ka uth gaya Ay meri Sakina\nMaara gaya, tera chacha, Ay meri Sakina
english translation text: Now you will be slapped and will no longer sleep upon his chest\nThe shade of your father has been taken away O my Sakina\nYour uncle has been killed, O my Sakina

arabic text: Mashkiza tera chid gaya, Paani tamaam beh gaya\nSukhaa rahega ye gala Ay meri Sakina\nMaara gaya, tera chacha, Ay meri Sakina
english translation text: Your water-skin was pierced and all the water flowed away\nThis throat will remain dry O my Sakina\nYour uncle has been killed, O my Sakina

arabic text: Baalon me khaak daal ab, Maqtal me sochuke hai sab\nBaba tera chacha tera Ay meri Sakina\nMaara gaya, tera chacha, Ay meri Sakina
english translation text: Now scatter dust into your hair; everyone has fallen asleep in the battlefield\nYour Baba and your uncle O my Sakina\nYour uncle has been killed, O my Sakina

arabic text: Ab to yateem ho gayi, sar pe rida nahi koi\nAshkonse pyaas ko bhujha Ay meri Sakina\nMaara gaya, tera chacha, Ay meri Sakina
english translation text: You are now an orphan, and there is no veil upon your head\nQuench your thirst with tears O my Sakina\nYour uncle has been killed, O my Sakina

arabic text: Abbas ko sadaa na de, be dast wo to ho chuke\nQismat me teri hai jafaa Ay meri Sakina
english translation text: Do not call for Abbas; he has been left without hands\nSuffering is written in your destiny O my Sakina

arabic text: Kaanonse beh raha hai khun, ek phal nahi tujhe sukun\nMarke na hogi tu rihaa Ay meri Sakina\nMaara gaya, tera chacha, Ay meri Sakina
english translation text: Blood flows from your ears; you have not a moment of peace\nEven death will not set you free O my Sakina\nYour uncle has been killed, O my Sakina

arabic text: \nKarbobala me aaj bhi, "Rehaan" sunte hai koi\nDeta hai shab ko ye sadaa Ay meri Sakina
english translation text: \nEven today in Karbala, "Rehan", someone can be heard\nGiving this call at night O my Sakina
